title: German discovery call where speech conflicts with the source

brief.text: Customer: Stadtwerke Lindenau (fictional). Current contract: 40 licences. Expansion conversation.

sources.title: Vertragsübersicht
sources.text: Aktueller Vertrag: 40 Lizenzen, Laufzeit bis 30.06. Preis je Lizenz 32 EUR/Monat.

turns.text: Wie viele Lizenzen nutzt ihr heute?
turns.translation: How many licences do you use today?

turns.text: Wir haben aktuell sechzig Lizenzen, und wir bräuchten noch etwa zwanzig dazu.
turns.translation: We currently have sixty licences, and we would need about twenty more.

turns.text: Das Budget gibt am Ende der Kaufmännische Leiter frei.
turns.translation: The commercial director releases the budget in the end.

mustInclude: Flags that Frank says sixty licences while the contract lists forty
Suggests clarifying whether twenty more means sixty or eighty in total
mustNotInclude: Accepts sixty licences as the contract count
checkpoints.ideal: Clarify the mismatch: the contract shows forty licences, Frank says sixty; does 'twenty more' mean sixty or eighty in total?

mustInclude: Asks a question that resolves the licence discrepancy or the real user count
mustNotInclude: Asks again who approves the budget
checkpoints.ideal: Ask whether the extra twenty seats are already in use informally, which would explain sixty versus the forty in the contract.
